5809203291389354623:
Dear Wanderer, as I write, I hope this finds you well.
Some time ago, this old man accompanied the Prefect on an inspection of the local school. There, I saw the children sitting upright, deeply engrossed in their books, so much so that they didn’t even notice our approach.
Curious, I wondered what marvelous texts could captivate these usually restless youngsters. Upon asking, I learned that they were reading books you had gifted them not long ago.
When I inquired what made these books so special, the children eagerly chimed in, and I realized you had thoughtfully chosen a different book for each child. Truly, you went above and beyond. Hearing that I knew you, they begged me to convey their gratitude.
Yet, when pressed to express their thanks aloud, they grew shy and tongue-tied. So, I suggested they put their thoughts into writing, and here they are, sealed within this letter. Rest assured, I didn’t peek!
Oh, and the children also entrusted me with a few drawings, inspired by the books you gave. They all agreed that you, Wanderer, have the finest taste and would surely appreciate their masterpieces.
Ha Ha, it seems that for any future tasks involving children, you’re the one to call.
